messages:
maya: heads up — gitops applied a terraform module update to aws-nodegroups in eu-west-2 that bumped launch config and autoscaling defaults. we're seeing a small wave of new GPU nodes without the gpu taint; several inference pods stuck Pending for ~15m.

sam: can you paste the reconcile errors / logs?

maya: here's kubectl describe on one of the pending pods:
```
Events:
  Normal SchedulingSucceeded  default-scheduler Successfully assigned inference/pod-xyz to ip-10-0-5-12
  Warning FailedAttachVolume attachdetachcontroller AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume ...
  Normal FailedScheduling 0/12 nodes are available: 4 node(s) didn't match node affinity, 8 Insufficient gpu.
```
Also terraform state shows module version 2.3.0 applied but gitops repo expects 2.2.1.

infra-bot: flux reconcile kustomization cluster - failed: helmrelease diff: values override mismatch (module_version).

diego: looks like module bumped autoscaling.max and removed the taint overlay we rely on for gpu scheduling. explains pods failing affinity. state drift between terraform and repo — probable manual terraform apply.

ops-sre: urgent — if we let these nodes persist they'll autoscale to the new min and incur cost. eu-west-2 has tight p4 capacity this week; we could burn quota/cost fast.

sam: temporary patch option — add taint back and let scheduler reschedule: `kubectl taint nodes <node> dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule --overwrite`. then drain/cordon carefully. avoid mass drains during traffic.

maya: trying taint now on two nodes. command used:
```
kubectl taint node ip-10-0-5-12 dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule --overwrite
```
Pods are rescheduling, some are coming up.

deploy-bot: canary rollout blocked: helm release redwood-inference/gpu-allocator - diff in values: `nodeTaint` missing in chart values.yaml.

lena: i'll open a hotfix PR to pin terraform module to 2.2.1 in gitops and add a preflight CI check that compares remote tfstate module versions. also adding a helm-values guard to require nodeTaint.

diego: we should `terraform state pull` and import any manual changes, then reconcile to the gitops desired state to stop flip-flopping. i'll coordinate with infra oncall.

ops-sre: +1 on pin + CI check. also add an alert for unexpected node taint removals (k8s audit) — will cut down recurring incidents.

maya: created PR #3421 (hotfix/pin-tf-module-and-values-guard). manual taint applied to 3 nodes, pods health back to normal. monitoring for 1hr. if nothing flares, we'll merge pin and follow up with state reconcile on Monday. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. follow-up ask: can we add a soft autoscaling guard in the module to cap gpu pools to max 6 and min 1 to avoid cost spikes from accidental bumps?

lena: adding that to the PR.

diego: logging complete. i'll run terraform plan in staging to simulate reconcile once PR merges to avoid surprises.

maya: closing the immediate alert. thanks team :thumbsup:
